description: Catalogo Parametrico dei Terremoti Italiani (CPTI15), versione 4.0 is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by emidius.mi.ingv.it. The Italian Parametric Earthquake Catalogue (CPTI, Catalogo Parametrico dei Terremoti Italiani) represents the most extensive and reliable source of parameters for earthquakes in Italy and surrounding areas. Coverage: IT. Its keywords include Earth sciences and geology, earthquake catalog, Italian Peninsula and adjacent islands, seismology, 945 General history of Europe, magnitude. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
